args.body: Take SOFTWARE-AWARD-BUYER-BRIEF. Missing end dates defeated the calendar specification, but verified purchases can still inform suppliers. Produce the brief itself from existing candidates rather than starting another scan. Official HTML may clarify API omissions; do not infer dates if it does not. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance, not this bounded delivery. Stop after the existing three-candidate limit, retain unknown demand, and leave public pages unchanged.

description: The renewal experiment found awarded software purchases but no explicit end dates in the inspected API records. That limits renewal forecasting, not the usefulness of verified purchasing evidence. Three feedback sources remain unclassified; demand is unknown. I will reuse the existing awards for one supplier-facing purchasing brief, without another market scan or claiming future tenders, customers or revenue.
